result.title: Fine-Grained Generative Hallucination Detection and Correction for Aerial Image Captioning
result.summary: Aerial imagery captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) plays a vital role in applications such as surveillance, disaster response, and large-scale environmental monitoring. Automatic generation of textual descriptions for such imagery is essential for reducing manual inspection overhead and enabling better downstream decision-making. However, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), despite their impressive captioning capabilities, are prone to hallucination, producing descriptions that are inconsistent with the visual input. This problem is significantly amplified in aerial imagery due to its unique challenges such as extreme viewpoint variation, small objects, class imbalance, and ambiguous visual entities. Existing hallucination detection approaches either rely on computationally expensive large external models such as GPT-4, which perform poorly on aerial domains, or treat the problem as a rigid binary classification task, ignoring the inherent uncertainty in ambiguous cases. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight, reference-free framework for hallucination detection and correction in free-form aerial image captioning. Our method leverages state-of-the-art MLLMs, specifically InternVL3 and Qwen2.5-VL, to detect hallucinated content in generated captions with minimal computational overhead. Detected hallucinations are corrected through a dedicated refinement module that improves the factual consistency of the original captions. Extensive experiments on the Labelled Illusion Dataset (LID) demonstrate that our framework significantly reduces hallucination rates while remaining practical for real-time deployment in resource-constrained environments. Code is available at: https://github.com/Debolena7/Hal_Detect.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向航拍图像描述的轻量、免参考幻觉检测与纠正框架，用 InternVL3、Qwen2.5-VL 定位描述中与图像不符的内容，再由精化模块改写，并在 LID 数据集上评估幻觉率下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 免参考的视觉不一致检测与纠正，可能为 LVR 中判断生成答案是否真正依据视觉证据提供低成本核查信号；但其不涉及 latent 状态或推理过程，是否可迁移仍需核查。
